name: AVT Natural Products Limited
about: AVT Natural Products Limited engages in the production, trading, and distribution of oleoresins, spices extract, and value-added tea and animal nutritional products in India, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers marigold extracts for eye care, food coloring, and poultry pigmentation; spice oleoresin and oils for food coloring and flavoring; value added teas, such as decaffeinated and instant teas; animal health and nutrition products; and agricultural crop inputs. It serves food, beverage, animal nutrition, and nutraceutical industries. AVT Natural Products Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Chennai, India.
